title: The Iliad and the Odyssey
examples: Who were the main characters in The Iliad?
What was the main difference between the Iliad and the Odyssey?
How did Odysseus get home to Ithaca?

explain.say: Today we explore two great Greek stories. We will learn about the Trojan War and Odysseus's long journey.
The first story is The Iliad. It tells us about the great war at Troy. This conflict was fought over a beautiful prize called Helen.
A key figure in The Iliad is Achilles. He was a very skilled warrior from the Greek side. His rage played a huge part in the fighting.

items: He was known for his fighting skill.

explain.say: The second story is The Odyssey. This follows Odysseus trying to get home after the war. His journey was filled with many dangers and monsters.
In the Odyssey, Odysseus faced many challenges. He had to outsmart creatures like the Cyclops. He also dealt with tricky goddesses.
In real life, these stories teach us about homecoming. They show the strong desire to return to your own family and place.

faq.a: It was a giant wooden horse left outside Troy. The Greeks tricked the Trojans into bringing it inside their city walls.
asks: How did the Greeks win the war?
What was the trick with the horse?

faq.q: Why is Odysseus's journey so long?
faq.a: His journey was long because the gods often interfered with his path. He had to overcome many obstacles to finally reach home.
asks: Did he travel for many years?
What made his trip so difficult?

faq.a: Achilles was a famous and powerful warrior in the Trojan War. He was considered one of the greatest fighters of his time.

faq.q: Are The Iliad and The Odyssey the same story?
faq.a: No, they are two separate epic poems. The Iliad focuses on the war, while the Odyssey focuses on the journey home.
asks: Do they tell the same events?

faq.a: An epic poem is a long, narrative poem about heroic deeds. These poems often feature gods and great battles.
asks: What kind of literature is this?
What do we call stories about heroes?

facts: The Iliad focuses on the final days of the Trojan War.
Odysseus's journey home is detailed in The Odyssey.
Achilles was a renowned warrior in the Trojan conflict.
The stories are foundational texts of Western literature.

quiz.say: The main conflict described in The Iliad is:

options.show: The discovery of the golden apple.
options.say: The discovery of the golden apple.

quiz.why: The Iliad centers on the fighting that began because of Helen.

wrong.0: This story relates to the beginning of the Trojan War, but not its main conflict.
wrong.2: This is the main focus of The Odyssey, not The Iliad.
wrong.3: This event happens much later in Odysseus's journey.

quiz.say: Odysseus's primary goal in The Odyssey is:
quiz.why: The entire plot of The Odyssey is driven by his struggle to get back to Ithaca.

wrong.0: Achilles is a character from The Iliad, not his main opponent here.
wrong.1: He is focused on reclaiming his original home, not finding a new one.
wrong.2: His goal is personal survival and restoration, not winning an object.

quiz.say: If a story focuses on a hero's struggle to survive many dangers on the sea, you are most likely reading about:
quiz.why: The Odyssey is famous for its perilous sea voyages and survival challenges.

wrong.0: The Iliad focuses more on the land battles around Troy.
wrong.1: While gods are involved, the specific journey described is Odysseus's.
wrong.2: This is a specific theme from The Iliad, not the journey home.
